claims.statement: RTE capacity expanded from 5,000 MT to 10,000 MT; additional 5,000 MT commissioned end of May-23
Total processing capacity 34,240 MTPA
Sales to capacity ratio below 50% offers headroom for growth
US subsidiary setup progressing, pending Indian regulatory approvals; benefits expected from FY25
Gross margins held due to EU market mix; RTE products fetch ~$0.50/kg higher margin
Overall capacity utilization dropped to 33% from 45%; RTE capacity added 5,000 MT but utilization low due to US demand drop
Depreciation to reduce by Rs 1 cr per quarter (Rs 4 cr annually) after useful life reassessment
RTE Capacity Expansion: Commissioned an additional line of 5,000 MT of RTE capacity in end of May-23
Awaiting regulatory approvals for selling RTE products (capacity of 10,000 MTPA) in the EU Market
Expect margin improvement as supply normalizes, more visible in Q3 FY25
EBITDA margin 6% in Q1 FY25, improved YoY and QoQ; freight costs up 60-70% pressuring margins
Shrimp volumes sold 2,571 MT in Q1 FY25 vs 2,302 MT in Q4 FY24 and 3,447 MT in Q1 FY24
US subsidiary setup pending RBI/banking approvals; targeting completion by month-end
Primary production re-entry under discussion at planning stage on company-owned land with technical focus
Overall demand-supply & pricing scenario improving for H2FY25
RTE capacity 10,000 MTPA awaiting EU regulatory approvals
Total processing capacity 34,240 MTPA
RTE capacity 10,000 MTPA at G. Ragampeta plant

Gross margin was 27% in Q2 FY25 due to higher raw material prices; H1 FY25 gross margin largely maintained at 29%. Freight cost inflation impacted EBITDA margins but freight costs are now normalizing.
Shrimp volumes sold: 2,710 MT in Q2 FY25 vs 2,571 MT in Q1 FY25 and 3,084 MT in Q2 FY24; H1 FY25 volumes 5,281 MT vs 6,531 MT in H1 FY24.

Hatchery revamp initiated to control seed supply; farming operations revamp planned for 2025 calendar year; new ready-to-eat facility of 10,000 MT plus 15,000 MT processing lacks EU regulatory approval.

Management expects better margins in upcoming quarters due to rising global prices, inventory liquidation, demand pickup, and freight cost normalization; confident of improved farmer stockings and supply.
Total processing capacity 34,240 MTPA across two plants
RTE capacity 10,000 MTPA at G. Ragampeta plant, awaiting EU regulatory approvals
Global shrimp demand and pricing improving for H2FY25; USA inventories clearing up; EU market robust
Gross margin declined to 25% in Q3 FY25 and 28% in 9M FY25 due to higher raw material prices
Shrimp volume sold reached 2,903 MT in Q3 FY25, up 37% YoY and 7% QoQ; 9M FY25 volume at 8,184 MT vs 8,646 MT in 9M FY24
Expect FY25 volumes flattish around last year's level (~10,000-11,000 MT), targeting ~12,000 MT for FY26 subject to supply improvement
Current capacity utilization around 35%, expected to improve if supply conditions get better in Q4
Order book intact and good; company waiting for supply to fulfill commitments
Expect RTE to contribute 15-20% of volumes in future, potentially higher if EU approvals secured for new facility
New facility capacity inaccessible for EU market due to pending regulatory approvals affecting both ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat
Total Processing Capacity 34,240 MTPA across two plants
Hatchery capacity 1.2-1.4 billion SPF seed
Cold Storage capacity ~3,500 MT
Management targets minimum 12,000 metric tons volume for FY26 but will not give margin guidance until end of Q1
Q4 FY25 capacity utilization was 20%; full year FY25 utilization was 30%
Total capacity is 34,200 metric tons; 25,000 metric tons unapproved by EU
Ready-to-eat production lines of 10,000 metric tons annual capacity await EU approval
Order book improved compared to earlier quarters; new programs being worked for Q4 calendar 2025 and Q1 calendar 2026
Q4 FY25 gross margin ~30%, up 500 bps QoQ from 25% in Q3 FY25 as farmgate prices corrected
No major investment planned for FY26 except power backup and efficiency improvements to reduce energy costs
Total processing capacity 34,240 MTPA across two plants with cold storage 3,500 MT
Hatchery capacity 1.2-1.4 billion SPF seed across three hatcheries
Management expects to maintain current margins if Q1 scenario persists, but highlights significant uncertainties from tariffs and supply situation
Gross margin improved to 34% in Q1 FY26, up 164 bps YoY and 382 bps QoQ, supported by farm gate price correction and higher realizations
EBITDA grew 66% YoY and 137% QoQ to INR 18 crores in Q1 FY26
Significant headroom exists to grow EU volumes without needing significant additional capacity in short to medium term
Hatchery Capacity 1.2-1.4 billion SPF seed
Target minimum 50% capacity utilization within next 1 year, aiming for 14,000-15,000 metric tonnes in FY26
Sustainable volume target of 18,000-20,000 metric tonnes at 70% capacity utilization in next 2-3 years
RTE facility expected to contribute 1,000 metric tonnes in FY26 and 2,000-2,500 metric tonnes in FY27
Target EBITDA margin of 10-12% as volumes grow and value-added mix increases
H1 FY26 gross margin 36% (vs 30% YoY); EBITDA margin 7.1% (vs 4% YoY)
Current capacity utilization ~30%; consolidated operations to one facility in Q2 FY26 to reduce costs
US tariffs on Indian shrimp lowered to 25% effective 7-Feb-26
US Trade Deal and EU FTA likely to adjust realizations, positive for Indian shrimp demand
RTE Capacity Expansion: Additional line of 5,000 MT commissioned end of May 2023
Total Processing Capacity 34,240 MTPA across two plants
Cold Storage capacity ~3,500 MT
Revenue expected to reach approximately INR 1,200-plus crores over the next 2 years
EBITDA margin expected to sustain at present level of around 7% and potentially reach 10% plus with ready-to-eat growth
Capacity utilization target of at least 50% by FY27 from current 33-35%
Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin improved 344 bps year-on-year to 6.5% driven by lower raw material prices and cost control
9M FY26 EBITDA margin of 6.9%, up 336 bps year-on-year
Non-U.S. export business grew from 37% to 51% of sales in 9M FY26, reflecting geographic diversification
EU sales grew 22% year-on-year in Q3 FY26 and 20% year-on-year in 9M FY26
U.S. sales declined 12% year-on-year in Q3 FY26 and 1% in 9M FY26
Two hatchery units in southern Andhra Pradesh operating efficiently; northern units not operational
Current capacity utilization around 33-35% for full year; ready-to-eat capacity utilization at 11% in 9M FY26 vs 10% last year
SPF seed breeding capacity
Processing capacity
Cold storage capacity
RTE capacity expanded by additional 5,000 MT line commissioned end of May 2023
Manufacturing capabilities in place to support business ramp-up and scalable growth
Expect volume growth in FY27, originally envisaged at almost 30% year-on-year, subject to no new issues and EU FTA implementation
Expect to sustain current EBITDA margins going forward, assuming stable market conditions and continued diversification
FY26 EBITDA grew 145% YoY to INR73 crores with margins expanding 405 bps to 7.7%; Q4 FY26 EBITDA grew 118% YoY to INR17 crores with margins expanding 593 bps to 9.8%
Order book growing across multiple markets; regaining U.S. volumes post tariff reduction to 10%; EU FTA expected to boost volumes further
Both facilities currently operating; capacity utilization at only 30% for full year, providing significant headroom for growth
Both processing facilities operating; new market approvals (e.g., Russia) being obtained for both facilities to support volume growth
Management expects FY27 shrimp sales volume of around 12,000 metric tons.
Management targets FY28 and FY29 volumes between 14,000 to 15,000 metric tons.
Management expects stable margins going forward, factoring in higher farm gate prices and freight costs but supported by volume growth and rupee depreciation.
RTE products carry a minimum margin premium of USD 0.50 per kilo over RTC products.
Q1 FY27 capacity utilization was 38%, similar to 39% in Q1 FY26; management targets consistent 35-40% utilization through FY27.
RTE capacity 10,000 MTPA at G. Ragampeta plant
Hatchery capacity 1.2-1.4 billion SPF seed
Management remains positive on reaching 12,000 metric tons volume target for FY27, expects 11,500-12,000 tons if no major cyclone damage
Expect EU FDA benefit by early 2027, enabling 0% tariff shrimp exports to EU by end of FY27 or start of next financial year
Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 6.4% vs 7.2% YoY, flat EBITDA at INR18 cr due to higher farm gate prices and freight costs
H1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 9.4% from 7.1% YoY, EBITDA up 40% to INR51 cr
Management passed on some farm gate price increases to overseas customers but limited by global competition from Ecuador, Vietnam, Indonesia
High-end product production creating capacity utilization limitations on certain lines; need to run all product types for customer needs
Order book and diversified markets provide good foresight on orders; confident of reaching volume targets if supply stable
